rounding_theorem: For integer R_A and real S_m, R_A<=S_m iff R_A<=floor(S_m); the irrational remainder cannot pay an integral demand.

carrier_creation_boundary: For arbitrary created carriers, all augmented Hall cuts must hold. A count of delta=max_T(|T|-|N(T)|) is sufficient only when the new carriers are universal.
